payload.description: Added ChatLog model for simplified agent-centric internal logging (distinct from user-facing ChatMessage)

model_added.name: ChatLog
model_added.purpose: Flat, session-less agent logging for internal debugging and analytics

payload.architectural_note: ChatLog coexists with ChatMessage/ChatSession for different purposes

use_cases.ChatMessage: User-facing persistent chat sessions with URLs (/chat/:slug), full continuity
use_cases.ChatLog: Internal agent activity logging, debugging traces, system-to-system chat without sessions

payload.resolution: Added ChatLog without removing existing ChatMessage/ChatSession hybrid model
verification: ChatLog is independent (no relations to ChatSession)
Indexes support agent-specific and time-based queries
payload.impact: Dual-track chat persistence: session-based for users + flat logging for agents/debugging
